name: Tolulope A. Kayode, PhD
bio: Dr. Kayode is a molecular epidemiologist studying malaria and other vector-borne and emerging infections, with a focus on diagnostics, transmission, and drug resistance. He holds a BSc and MSc in Microbiology and a PhD in Molecular Biology and Genomics, and completed his postdoctoral training at the University of Notre Dame, USA. He enjoys mentoring students, spending time with his family, and participating in community activities.
